GRADE 7 AGRICULTURE — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Time: 56 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Controlling Soil Pollution in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the causes of soil pollution in gardening,
   B. Learners should ignore Controlling Soil Pollution completely.
   C. Controlling Soil Pollution is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Controlling Soil Pollution.

2. About Controlling Soil Pollution around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. control soil pollution in the home environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Controlling Soil Pollution completely.
   C. Controlling Soil Pollution is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Controlling Soil Pollution.

3. About Controlling Soil Pollution in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the causes of soil pollution in gardening,
   B. Learners should ignore Controlling Soil Pollution completely.
   C. Controlling Soil Pollution is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Controlling Soil Pollution.

5. About Constructing Water Retention Structures in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe how surface run-off can be used in gardening
   B. Learners should ignore Constructing Water Retention Structures completely.
   C. Constructing Water Retention Structures is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Constructing Water Retention Structures.

6. About Constructing Water Retention Structures around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. construct water retention structures to conserve surface runoff,
   B. Learners should ignore Constructing Water Retention Structures completely.
   C. Constructing Water Retention Structures is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Constructing Water Retention Structures.

7. About Constructing Water Retention Structures in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe how surface run-off can be used in gardening
   B. Learners should ignore Constructing Water Retention Structures completely.
   C. Constructing Water Retention Structures is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Constructing Water Retention Structures.

9. About Conserving Food Nutrients in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify ways of conserving vitamins and minerals in vegetables
   B. Learners should ignore Conserving Food Nutrients completely.
   C. Conserving Food Nutrients is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Conserving Food Nutrients.

10. About Conserving Food Nutrients around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. conserve vitamins and minerals in vegetables
   B. Learners should ignore Conserving Food Nutrients completely.
   C. Conserving Food Nutrients is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Conserving Food Nutrients.

11. About Conserving Food Nutrients in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify ways of conserving vitamins and minerals in vegetables
   B. Learners should ignore Conserving Food Nutrients completely.
   C. Conserving Food Nutrients is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Conserving Food Nutrients.

13. About Growing Trees in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment
   B. Learners should ignore Growing Trees completely.
   C. Growing Trees is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Growing Trees.

14. About Growing Trees around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. plant trees to conserve the environment
   B. Learners should ignore Growing Trees completely.
   C. Growing Trees is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Growing Trees.

15. About Growing Trees in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment
   B. Learners should ignore Growing Trees completely.
   C. Growing Trees is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Growing Trees.

17. About Crop Establishment Planting Site in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. determine appropriate tilth for selected planting material,
   B. Learners should ignore Crop Establishment Planting Site completely.
   C. Crop Establishment Planting Site is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Crop Establishment Planting Site.

18. About Crop Establishment Planting Site around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. prepare a suitable tilth for establishing selected planting material,
   B. Learners should ignore Crop Establishment Planting Site completely.
   C. Crop Establishment Planting Site is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Crop Establishment Planting Site.

19. About Crop Establishment Planting Site in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. determine appropriate tilth for selected planting material,
   B. Learners should ignore Crop Establishment Planting Site completely.
   C. Crop Establishment Planting Site is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Crop Establishment Planting Site.

21. About Selected Crop Management Practises in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain management practises carried out on crops
   B. Learners should ignore Selected Crop Management Practises completely.
   C. Selected Crop Management Practises is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected Crop Management Practises.

22. About Selected Crop Management Practises around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. carry out management practises in crop production
   B. Learners should ignore Selected Crop Management Practises completely.
   C. Selected Crop Management Practises is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected Crop Management Practises.

23. About Selected Crop Management Practises in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain management practises carried out on crops
   B. Learners should ignore Selected Crop Management Practises completely.
   C. Selected Crop Management Practises is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected Crop Management Practises.

25. About Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene completely.
   C. Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

26. About Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene completely.
   C. Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

27. About Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene completely.
   C. Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
